title: Math Challenge
tagline: From counting ducks to algebraic topology.
description: A math challenge game from age 4 to professional mathematician, in seven locales. Practice is free forever, and we publish the research behind every decision.
intro: A math challenge game spanning ages 4 to professional mathematician. A parent registers and creates profiles for their children; an adaptive placement test sets the difficulty while age sets the visual theme. Two separate axes, deliberately.
how: Challenges are built from an item bank and scored server-side. Larry, the orange rhino, explains what went right and where the reasoning went off track — like a patient professor, never like an examiner.
p1: Practice is free forever. We never charge a child for doing mathematics.
p2: A child is never a user — only a profile inside a parent's account.
p3: Never camera, microphone, or biometrics. For anyone, at any tier.
p4: A screen-time limit never breaks a streak.
p5: Larry never shames a child for being wrong.
research: Forty-seven studies, about 157,000 words, with cited sources and declared limitations — including the passages where the evidence contradicts this product.
status: In construction. No public release yet.
sponsor: A project by Ignia, running on Cloudflare.
signupParentLead: One account for the grown-up. Each child is a profile inside it — never a user, never an email address of their own.
signupTeacherLead: One account for you. Your students join as profiles; they never sign up, and they never type their name.
signupLearnerLead: For you, learning maths for yourself. Same account, same two fields.
signupPasswordHint: At least 8 characters. No uppercase-and-a-number rules: length is what matters, and those rules just produce passwords people write down.
signupTwoFields: Two fields. That is the whole form.
signupWhyTwo: Everything else is asked later, in the moment it is needed, where we can explain why. Going from four fields to three raised completions by about half in 40,000 forms.
signupNoChildData: We never ask for a child's name, email, photo or date of birth.
profileNewLead: Three things, all optional, all changeable later. Skip every one of them and your child can still play — practice is free, always.
profileMarkAge: Age is not difficulty. The year only decides how the game looks — huge buttons, or a dark screen. Where your child actually starts is decided by the game itself, in the first few challenges, and it moves along with them.
profileMarkProfile: Your child is a profile inside your account, not a user of their own. That is why this page has no name, no email, no photo and no date of birth — and why they will never be asked to type anything.
profileYearHelp: The year, and nothing else. Not the month, not the day: the year is all we need to pick how the game looks.
profileThemeHelp: Already chosen from the year. You can move it one step up or one step down, never further — further along, no voice reads the instructions aloud any more.
profileThemeKinderWhat: Huge buttons, Larry reads everything aloud, nothing to read.
profileThemePrimariaWhat: Colour, short sentences, and a map of what comes next.
profileThemeSecundariaWhat: Dark by default, no baby talk, a quicker pace.
profileThemeOutOfRange: Too far from the year you gave.
profileAliasHelp: We made this one up. Neither you nor your child types it: no child writes free text anywhere in this product, so there is no box for anyone to put a real name into.
profileGuardianDeclaration: By creating the profile you confirm you are this child's parent or guardian. We record that you said so — the date, and nothing else about the child.
profileSkipAllHelp: “Not now” creates the profile exactly as it stands. Nothing here is locked in, nothing costs money, and no step on this page can ever stop a child from practising.
kidsNobodyYet: There are no profiles on this account yet.
pinHelp: Three pictures, always in the same order. Nothing is ever typed here.
pinTryAgain: Not those three. Tap again — nothing is lost.
signinFormLead: The account belongs to the grown-up. Children get in on their own device, by tapping their picture.
signinChildNote: Children never sign in here. They tap their picture on a device an adult marked as one of the household devices.
installWhy: Install Math Challenge on your home screen. An installed app keeps offline progress: browsers clear a website's storage after seven days, and an installed one is exempt.
markProfileNotUser: Your child is a profile inside your account — never a user. They have no email, no password of their own, and nothing they write is stored, because they never write anything.
markAgeVsDifficulty: Age decides how the app LOOKS; a placement decides where they START. Two separate axes, on purpose: a seven-year-old can be at level 2 and another at level 5, and both see the same interface.
formErrGenerico: That didn't go through. Please try again.
formErrCredenciales: That email and password don't match an account.
formErrClave: The password needs between 8 and 64 characters.
formErrDemasiados: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
formErrAlias: That name is already taken in your account. Pick another.
formErrEdadAdulto: That year is an adult's. An adult opens their own account.
casaLead: Everything for your children lives here.
casaSinHijos: No profiles yet. Create the first one to start playing.
casaActivarTexto: Add a child or create a classroom whenever you like. It's optional, and nothing about your own practice changes.
casaAparatoTexto: Your children can only play on devices you mark. On a borrowed or public device, do not mark it.
casaAparatoListo: Marked. Your children can play here.
casaPasskeyTexto: Add a passkey and use your face or fingerprint next time. Your password keeps working.
casaPasskeyListo: Done. You can sign in with it now.
casaOtraCuenta: Sign in with a different account
casaClaveListo: Done. Your other devices were signed out.
casaProgresoProximamente: Your children's progress panel is being built.
casaPracticarProximamente: We're building content for adults learning on their own. Check back soon.
practicarLead: Challenges, one after another. Play as long as you like.
practicarAviso: Right now the bank has primary-level content. Adult levels are planned, not built.
perfilFamiliaTexto: Create a profile for each child and you'll get their tabs: their profiles, their progress and their screen time. If you're practising on your own, ignore this — nothing here needs it.
perfilLead: Your details, your password and your passkeys.
perfilActualizarTexto: Clears this app's local cache without signing you out or deleting profiles.
signinPasskeyDesconocida: That passkey isn't registered here yet. Sign in with your password, then add one from your account.
